title: LISD Wellness Conference Connects Parents With 30 Community Groups
excerpt: Laredo ISD hosted a wellness conference for parents on Friday, Nov. 20, with three keynote speakers and about 30 organizations and community agencies on hand to connect families with resources and support services.
content:
The Laredo Independent School District hosted a wellness conference for parents on Friday morning to connect them with community resources and support services.

The event featured three keynote speakers. Topics included nutrition and vision, stress management and healthy eating tips for children.

About 30 organizations and community agencies took part in the wellness fair.

District officials said the goal is to support families, with the student as the priority.

“We want to educate our parents so that they know how to deal with their kids, what is best for them, and for them to be educated on having healthy kids makes them be successful at the school,” Claudia Garcia said.

Source: Laredo Independent School District, Nov. 20, 2026.
